features.definition: Other-user counterargument comments: overall cognitive complexity (0-10) of the reasoning, i.e. differentiating multiple perspectives or considerations and integrating them, versus one-dimensional reasoning.
features.spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; list order is not rank or chronology). Parse the list. Return 1 if at least one comment employs a specific, concrete illustrative example (a particular named or clearly described case, instance, scenario or personal experience used to illustrate or support its point; not merely a vague generalization or abstract principle). hypotheses.hypothesis: Discussions where the original argument includes explicit comparisons to established scientific or historical norms are associated with lower view change than those without such comparisons.
hypotheses.h0: There is no association between argument_compares_to_established_norms and view change (delta).
hypotheses.h1: Rows with argument_compares_to_established_norms=1 have lower delta than rows with 0.
hypotheses.note: Measured on current supplied argument text (including marked edits) after excluding outcome announcements; initial snapshot is not reconstructed. Association only, not causal.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Arguments expressing explicit fear of social rejection or isolation are associated with lower view-change rates than arguments stating beliefs without emotional self-defense.
hypotheses.h0: View-change rates do not differ between rows with op_expresses_fear_of_social_rejection_or_isolation and rows with op_states_beliefs_without_emotional_self_defense.
hypotheses.h1: Rows with op_expresses_fear_of_social_rejection_or_isolation have lower view-change rates than rows with op_states_beliefs_without_emotional_self_defense.
hypotheses.note: The claim compares group A (explicit fear) versus named group B (beliefs without emotional self-defense), not A versus not-A. In the joint OLS, each coefficient is relative to rows in neither group, so the A-versus-B contrast (beta_A - beta_B) is not a single design-matrix coefficient; term=null. Analysis would need subsetting to A or B rows or a linear contrast, not available here. Measures are current-text linguistic judgments of OP title/argument, not observed psychological states; no initial snapshot is reconstructed. Associations only.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Counter-arguments that cite specific, functioning institutional precedents are associated with a higher probability of view change than those relying on abstract normative principles.

hypotheses.h1: Comments citing functioning institutional precedents are associated with higher delta probability than comments relying on abstract normative principles.
hypotheses.note: The claim is a contrast (precedent beta greater than normative beta), which no single coefficient in this OLS represents; beta_precedent alone is not beta_precedent minus beta_normative, so term=null. Features are row-level any-indicators and may overlap (a row can have both); comment-level comparison and exclusive groups are not available. OC_comments order is unknown; no per-comment outcomes. Associations only.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Discussions featuring longer precomputed log-transformed discussion length are associated with a higher likelihood of the original poster changing their view.

right_feature.spec: Read title, argument (OP context) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP; parse it first). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly quotes or references a specific textual element of the OP's post (title or argument), e.g. a quoted phrase/sentence or an explicit pointer to a specific stated passage or claim; agreement, refutation or endorsement is not required. Generic topic mentions without pointing to specific OP text do not count. Quotation marks alone do not suffice unless the quoted text matches or clearly refers to the OP's text. Judge each comment separately; list order carries no meaning. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if the OP title/argument is missing so that absence cannot be established (a clear positive match against available OP text still gives 1). Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if in the argument; do not use them as the quoted/referenced OP text or as evidence. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. Use current supplied text including marked edits; do not reconstruct an initial snapshot.

left_feature.spec: Read OP title and argument (for context; premises must be factual claims made in the OP's argument text) and OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments; parse it). Count the distinct factual premises (empirical/factual claims, not values or purely normative claims) in the OP's argument that are challenged (disputed, contradicted, or shown to be false/unsupported with a factual objection) by at least one comment. Each distinct premise counts once even if several comments challenge it; one comment challenging two different premises counts both. Ignore challenges to the title's value judgments, to reasoning not tied to a stated factual premise, and to claims not made by the OP. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement and remains eligible. Use supplied current text including marked edits; do not reconstruct an initial snapshot. Comment list order carries no meaning. Output a non-negative integer. Valid empty comment list -> 0. Missing/malformed OC_comments or missing argument -> null. No challenged factual premise -> 0.

right_feature.spec: Read title, argument (OP context) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP; parse it first). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly quotes or references a specific textual element of the OP's post (title or argument), e.g. a quoted phrase/sentence or an explicit pointer to a specific stated passage or claim; agreement, refutation or endorsement is not required. Generic topic mentions without pointing to specific OP text do not count. Quotation marks alone do not suffice unless the quoted text matches or clearly refers to the OP's text. Judge each comment separately; list order carries no meaning. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if the OP title/argument is missing so that absence cannot be established (a clear positive match against available OP text still gives 1). Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if in the argument; do not use them as the quoted/referenced OP text or as evidence. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. Use current supplied text including marked edits; do not reconstruct an initial snapshot.

left_feature.name: distinct_counter_argument_count
left_feature.definition: Other-user comments: number of distinct counter-arguments against the OP's view, deduplicated across comments (not the comment count).
left_feature.spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP), parsed as a list, with title and argument only as context to identify the OP's view. Return a non-negative integer: the number of semantically distinct counter-arguments to the OP's view made across all comments. Several comments making the same point count once; one comment making several different points counts each. Do not count agreement, questions, clarifications, jokes, or off-topic remarks. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if in argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement but is not itself a counter-argument unless it argues against the OP's view. Use current supplied text; list order is not rank or chronology. Valid empty list gives 0. Missing or malformed OC_comments gives null. Anchors: 0 = none, 1 = one distinct argument, 3 = three distinct arguments.

right_feature.name: counterargument_cognitive_complexity
right_feature.definition: Other-user counterargument comments: overall cognitive complexity (0-10) of the reasoning, i.e. differentiating multiple perspectives or considerations and integrating them, versus one-dimensional reasoning.
right_feature.spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; list order is not rank or chronology). Parse the list. Ignore any text reporting OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is allowed and is not an outcome announcement. Score each comment's cognitive complexity 0-10: 0 = no reasoning/argument (e.g., empty, pure insult, bare assertion); 2 = single one-dimensional claim with minimal justification; 4 = some reasoning but treats the issue in a single frame; 6 = acknowledges multiple considerations, perspectives, or tradeoffs; 8 = differentiates several perspectives or conditions and weighs them, noting nuance or limits; 10 = differentiates multiple perspectives and integrates them into a coherent, conditional higher-order synthesis. Aggregation assumption (operational, not part of the hypothesis): the row value is the mean of the comment scores across all comments. Do not use quoted/attributed text as the commenter's own reasoning unless adopted. Output one number in [0,10]. If the list is a valid empty list, or missing/malformed, return null.

right_feature.spec: Read title, argument (OP context) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP; parse it first). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly quotes or references a specific textual element of the OP's post (title or argument), e.g. a quoted phrase/sentence or an explicit pointer to a specific stated passage or claim; agreement, refutation or endorsement is not required. Generic topic mentions without pointing to specific OP text do not count. Quotation marks alone do not suffice unless the quoted text matches or clearly refers to the OP's text. Judge each comment separately; list order carries no meaning. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if the OP title/argument is missing so that absence cannot be established (a clear positive match against available OP text still gives 1). Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if in the argument; do not use them as the quoted/referenced OP text or as evidence. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. Use current supplied text including marked edits; do not reconstruct an initial snapshot.

Exclude and never use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if in argument or comments; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be retained.

left_feature.spec: Read title, argument (OP text, for identifying the OP's cited examples and premises) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly engages with a specific example or premise stated in the OP's argument/title, e.g. by referring to, quoting, paraphrasing, rebutting, questioning or building on that particular example or premise; agreement or disagreement both count. Return 0 if comments only discuss the general topic, raise unrelated new points, or make generic statements without addressing a specific OP-cited example or premise. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, wherever they appear (including in argument); do not use them as evidence. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement but is not engagement with an OP example/premise unless it addresses one. Use current supplied text, including marked edits, without inferring timing or order. Empty comment list: return 0. Missing or malformed OC_comments, or missing OP argument/title needed to identify OP examples/premises: return null.

right_feature.definition: Other-user counterargument comments: overall cognitive complexity (0-10) of the reasoning, i.e. differentiating multiple perspectives or considerations and integrating them, versus one-dimensional reasoning.

Score each comment's cognitive complexity 0-10: 0 = no reasoning/argument (e.g., empty, pure insult, bare assertion); 2 = single one-dimensional claim with minimal justification; 4 = some reasoning but treats the issue in a single frame; 6 = acknowledges multiple considerations, perspectives, or tradeoffs; 8 = differentiates several perspectives or conditions and weighs them, noting nuance or limits; 10 = differentiates multiple perspectives and integrates them into a coherent, conditional higher-order synthesis. Aggregation assumption (operational, not part of the hypothesis): the row value is the mean of the comment scores across all comments. Do not use quoted/attributed text as the commenter's own reasoning unless adopted. Output one number in [0,10]. If the list is a valid empty list, or missing/malformed, return null.

right_feature.spec: Read title and argument (the OP's view; context for identifying the target) and parse OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment directly counterargues the OP's stated view, i.e. it explicitly offers reasoning, evidence or examples against the OP's claim or rebuts the OP's reasoning. Return 0 if the list is valid and nonempty but no comment does (e.g. only agreement, clarifying questions, off-topic, jokes, moderator/bot notices). Return 0 for a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title and argument are both missing so the target view cannot be identified. Ignore and never use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if in argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement and may be retained. Use current supplied text; list order implies no chronology or rank. Output a single 0/1 per row.

right_feature.name: counterargument_cognitive_complexity
right_feature.definition: Other-user counterargument comments: overall cognitive complexity (0-10) of the reasoning, i.e. differentiating multiple perspectives or considerations and integrating them, versus one-dimensional reasoning.
right_feature.spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; list order is not rank or chronology). Parse the list. Ignore any text reporting OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is allowed and is not an outcome announcement. Score each comment's cognitive complexity 0-10: 0 = no reasoning/argument (e.g., empty, pure insult, bare assertion); 2 = single one-dimensional claim with minimal justification; 4 = some reasoning but treats the issue in a single frame; 6 = acknowledges multiple considerations, perspectives, or tradeoffs; 8 = differentiates several perspectives or conditions and weighs them, noting nuance or limits; 10 = differentiates multiple perspectives and integrates them into a coherent, conditional higher-order synthesis. Aggregation assumption (operational, not part of the hypothesis): the row value is the mean of the comment scores across all comments. Do not use quoted/attributed text as the commenter's own reasoning unless adopted. Output one number in [0,10]. If the list is a valid empty list, or missing/malformed, return null.

Score each comment's cognitive complexity 0-10: 0 = no reasoning/argument (e.g., empty, pure insult, bare assertion); 2 = single one-dimensional claim with minimal justification; 4 = some reasoning but treats the issue in a single frame; 6 = acknowledges multiple considerations, perspectives, or tradeoffs; 8 = differentiates several perspectives or conditions and weighs them, noting nuance or limits; 10 = differentiates multiple perspectives and integrates them into a coherent, conditional higher-order synthesis. Aggregation assumption (operational, not part of the hypothesis): the row value is the mean of the comment scores across all comments. Do not use quoted/attributed text as the commenter's own reasoning unless adopted. Output one number in [0,10]. If the list is a valid empty list, or missing/malformed, return null.

right_feature.spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; list order is not rank or chronology). Parse the list. Ignore any text reporting OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is allowed and is not an outcome announcement. Score each comment's cognitive complexity 0-10: 0 = no reasoning/argument (e.g., empty, pure insult, bare assertion); 2 = single one-dimensional claim with minimal justification; 4 = some reasoning but treats the issue in a single frame; 6 = acknowledges multiple considerations, perspectives, or tradeoffs; 8 = differentiates several perspectives or conditions and weighs them, noting nuance or limits; 10 = differentiates multiple perspectives and integrates them into a coherent, conditional higher-order synthesis. Aggregation assumption (operational, not part of the hypothesis): the row value is the mean of the comment scores across all comments. Do not use quoted/attributed text as the commenter's own reasoning unless adopted. Output one number in [0,10]. If the list is a valid empty list, or missing/malformed, return null.

right_feature.spec: Read title and argument (OP claim context) and parse OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments, not the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment tells a concrete, specific personal anecdote or lived experience (actual, not hypothetical or invented) that illustrates real-world consequences of the OP's claim as identified from title/argument. Ignore the OP's own text as evidence for this measurement except to identify the claim. Exclude from evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement. left_feature.name: any_comment_quotes_op_text

left_feature.spec: Read title, argument (OP text) and OC_comments (a JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parse it first). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly and directly quotes wording that appears in the OP's title or argument (verbatim or near-verbatim reproduced text, e.g. in quotation marks or block-quote formatting, matching available OP text). Endorsement or refutation of the quote is not required. Paraphrases or summaries of the OP's view without reproduced wording do not count; quotations of other sources or of other commenters do not count; quotation marks alone do not suffice unless the quoted text matches OP title/argument. Ignore and do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred (including inside argument); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement and is retained. Use current supplied text; do not infer an initial snapshot. Return 0 if the comment list is valid and empty, or if all comments are assessable and none quotes OP text. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title/argument is missing/unavailable such that absence of a quote cannot be established (a positive match against available OP text still yields 1). Output a single 0/1 or null.

right_feature.spec: Read title and argument (OP's view, as context for the target) and parse OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments; order is not rank or chronology). Return 1 if the list is non-empty and every comment expresses support or agreement with the OP's view, with no comment challenging it. Return 0 if the list is valid and at least one comment is not supportive (e.g. counterargument, neutral, or off-topic). Return null if OC_comments is missing/malformed, empty, or OP context needed to identify the target is missing. Ignore moderator/bot notices. Exclude and never use as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates or any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even in argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is retained. Use current supplied text; do not infer snapshots.

left_feature.name: any_comment_cites_specific_concrete_real_world_example
left_feature.definition: Other-user counter-argument comments: at least one comment explicitly references a specific, concrete example or real-world instance (actual case, event, person, place, study or personal experience), not merely a hypothetical or generic claim.
left_feature.spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parse it). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly references a specific, concrete example or real-world instance in support of its counter-argument (e.g. a named or identifiable actual event, person, organization, place, study, historical case, or a specific personal experience). Illustrative types are nonexhaustive; external verification is not required. Invented/hypothetical scenarios, vague generalities and purely abstract reasoning do not count. Quotes or cites from others count only if the example itself is a specific real case used by the comment. Ignore any text that is an OP view-change/delta-award announcement, post-outcome thank-you/resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither outcome text nor an example. List order carries no meaning. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Output a single 0/1 per row.

Ignore the OP's own text as evidence, and ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even in argument); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither such an announcement nor an example. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including an empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if OP context needed to identify the view is missing. Output a single 0/1.

left_feature.name: any_comment_well_reasoned_counterargument
left_feature.definition: Other-user comments: at least one comment presents a well-reasoned counterargument (logically coherent, supported reasoning) against the OP's stated view.
left_feature.spec: Read title and argument (OP's view, for context only) and OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments; parse it). Return 1 if at least one comment presents a well-reasoned counterargument to the OP's view, meaning it directly opposes the OP's claim with logically coherent, supported reasoning (not mere assertion, insult or off-topic remark). Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment does. Empty valid list -> 0. Missing/malformed OC_comments or missing OP context needed to identify the target -> null. Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if in argument or comments; do not use them as evidence. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be retained if relevant. Use current supplied text; no chronology is implied by list order.
